actions.openGoogleTagManager.label: Google Tag Manager
actions.openGoogleTagManager.description: Configure the GTM container and server-side tagging per sales channel
settingGroups.google_tag_manager.name: Google Tag Manager
settingLabels.google_tag_manager.enabled: Loads the GTM container on this sales channel. Do not also load Google Analytics for it.
settingLabels.google_tag_manager.contain: GTM container ID (GTM-XXXXXXX). Empty: the channel is not tracked.
settingLabels.google_tag_manager.require: The container starts with consent denied and no event is sent until the visitor accepts cookies.
settingLabels.google_tag_manager.server_: Sends commerce events to your server-side GTM container from the backend instead of the browser.
Base URL of your server-side GTM container. Empty keeps the channel on the browser path.
The path your server container's client listens on. Default /data matches Google's Data Client.
module.name: Google Tag Manager
module.description: Google Tag Manager integration: per-sales-channel container injection behind the storefront consent decision, a documented commerce dataLayer vocabulary, and an optional server-side tagging relay.
